title: Audiologist, Radiographer and More – 33 Posts
age_limit: 35 years & below (Blood Bank Technician); 45 years & below (District Account Assistant, Multipurpose Hospital Worker/Support Staff)
summary: DHS Nilgiris invites applications for temporary contractual positions including Audiologist, Radiographer, Blood Bank Technician, Counsellor, and other support staff across various government medical facilities. Eligible candidates must submit their filled applications by December 7, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Educational qualifications vary by post ranging from 8th Pass, High School/Diploma, +2 Science, to Bachelor's/Master's Degrees in relevant fields like Audiology, Radiography, Medical Laboratory Technology, Social Work, and Special Education.
Age limits apply to specific posts such as 35 years and below for Blood Bank Technician and 45 years and below for District Account Assistant and Multipurpose Hospital Worker/Support Staff.
Mandatory registrations (such as RCI registration where applicable) and specific training certifications are required as per the post requirements.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official website nilgiris.nic.in.
Fill out the application form and attach self-attested copies of required educational certificates, community certificates, and experience proofs along with a passport-size photograph.
Submit the completed application in person or via speed post to the District Health Officer, No.38 Jail Hill Road, Near CT Scan, Udhagamandalam 643001 on or before 07.12.2026 by 5:00 PM.
